_comment: Code Factory Risk Policy for fluentify-v2 — a Chrome browser extension.
_comment_context: This is a browser extension. Background scripts and content scripts run with full Chrome permissions in the user's browser. Changes to these files are CRITICAL HIGH RISK because a bug can compromise user security or crash the extension for all users. The manifest.ts controls what permissions the extension requests — changes there can silently expand attack surface.
_comment_usage: Parsed by scripts/risk-policy-check.js at PR time. Bump the version field on every change so downstream audits can detect contract changes.

riskTierRules._comment: Files matching ANY pattern in 'high.patterns' are classified HIGH risk. A PR is HIGH tier if even one changed file matches. Everything else is LOW. Uses minimatch glob syntax.

high.description: Background service worker, content scripts, extension manifest, core libraries, shared hooks, options page, build config, CI/CD. Changes here require full review pipeline: AI code review + CI. Background/content scripts run with full Chrome extension permissions — a bug here affects every user session.

low._comment: Catch-all. Covers popup UI (src/popup/**), types (src/types/**), static data (src/data/**), and styles. Standard automated gate + CI is sufficient.
low.description: Popup UI components, type definitions, static data, styles, docs, assets. Standard automated gate + CI is sufficient.

mergePolicy._comment: Required status check names per risk tier. These strings must match your GitHub branch protection rule check names EXACTLY (case-sensitive). The CI check name 'Build & Type Check' matches the existing ci.yml job name exactly.

high._comment: Three checks required for high-risk PRs. code-review-agent = Greptile or CodeRabbit approved. 'Build & Type Check' = the existing ci.yml job (typecheck + lint + build + test). All three must pass before merge.

low._comment: Low-risk PRs need the policy gate and CI. No AI review required for popup UI, types, data, or style changes.

docsDriftRules._comment: Disabled — fluentify-v2 does not have a docs/ folder. Re-enable this when a docs/ directory is established for the project.

rules._comment: Disabled — no docs/ folder in this repo.
Disabled — no docs/ folder in this repo. See CODE_FACTORY.md for policy documentation.

browserEvidence._comment: Browser evidence configuration. NOTE: For fluentify-v2, this is a Chrome EXTENSION — not a web app. Traditional browser evidence (staging URL + screenshot manifest) is N/A. Extension evidence is captured differently: loading the unpacked extension in Chrome and running extension-specific tests. The browser-evidence check is NOT included in requiredChecks for this reason. If browser-extension-specific evidence capture is implemented in the future, update mergePolicy.high.requiredChecks accordingly.
browserEvidence._comment_na: browser-evidence is N/A for Chrome extensions. Evidence must be captured by loading the unpacked extension build in Chrome DevTools, not by navigating to a staging URL.

harnessGap._comment: When a production regression is detected and no test case covers it, create a GitHub Issue labeled 'harness-gap' and merge a new Vitest test case within 3 days.
harnessGap.label: harness-gap

remediation._comment: Safety guardrails for the auto-remediation loop. After 3 failed auto-remediation attempts on a single commit SHA, the workflow stops and requires human intervention. Counter resets when a new commit is pushed (new SHA). Agent is set to codex — configure OPENAI_API_KEY secret in repository settings.
